# reader — the demo, at 1280x820.
#
# Every book in it was generated by this program or by another app in this
# repository: nothing of the user's is opened, named or shown.
#
# Run it with the library seeded first:
#   PALMY_READER_HOME=$PWD/apps/reader/demo/state \
#     bash apps/tools/headless-record.sh apps/reader/reader.bin \
#       apps/reader/demo.mp4 apps/reader/demo.txt 1280 820

wait 1.4

# --- the library: six books, covers, formats
move 104 187
wait 0.5
move 288 187
wait 0.4
move 472 187
wait 0.4
move 840 187
wait 0.5
move 1024 187
wait 0.6

# open the large EPUB
move 104 187
wait 0.4
click
wait 1.8

# --- turning pages: click the right third of the page
move 1050 430
wait 0.5
click
wait 1.0
click
wait 1.0
click
wait 1.0
# and back, with the keyboard
key Left
wait 1.0

# --- the type size, and the text reflowing to it
key plus
wait 0.8
key plus
wait 0.8
key plus
wait 1.4
key minus
wait 0.7
key minus
wait 1.3

# --- the three themes
key 2
wait 1.4
key 3
wait 1.4
key 1
wait 1.0

# --- justified instead of ragged
key u
wait 1.5
key u
wait 1.0

# --- the table of contents, and a jump from it
key t
wait 1.4
move 1010 290
wait 0.5
click
wait 1.8
key Escape
wait 1.0

# --- search within the book
key slash
wait 0.8
type Gutenberg
wait 1.6
key Return
wait 1.4
key Return
wait 1.4
key Escape
wait 1.0

# --- continuous scroll instead of pages
key m
wait 1.4
key Down
key Down
key Down
key Down
wait 1.2
key m
wait 1.0

# --- a bookmark, and the list of them
key b
wait 1.0
key l
wait 1.6
key Escape
wait 0.8

# --- back to the library, and into a fixed-page document
key g
wait 1.4
move 840 187
wait 0.5
click
wait 2.6

# a PDF has no type size: it has fit and zoom
key f
wait 1.8
key plus
wait 1.8
key w
wait 1.8
move 1050 430
wait 0.4
click
wait 1.8
click
wait 2.0

# its outline, read out of the PDF's own bookmarks
key t
wait 1.6
move 1010 200
wait 0.4
click
wait 2.2
key Escape
wait 1.2

key g
wait 1.6
